question: What posture and quantity of recitation are required in this stage of the practice?
premises: The practitioner grasps the pair of feet
A hundred thousand syllables or repetitions are prescribed
The mantra is the object of recitation
inference: Grasping the pair of feet, the practitioner should recite the mantra one hundred thousand times.
uncertainties: Whether varṇalakṣaṃ means a hundred thousand syllables or a hundred thousand repetitions
plain_english: Having grasped the pair of feet, one should recite the mantra one hundred thousand times.
